headline: Baycurrent Classic: Michael Brennan wins at 16 under with a closing 68
whyCareReason: Brennan finished one shot clear of Mitchell and Bridgeman. The winner's check is $1.44 million. Homa tied for 13th at 11 under.
teaser: Final at Yokohama Country Club: Brennan 268 (-16). Mitchell and Bridgeman -15.
story: Michael Brennan won the Baycurrent Classic with a final-round 68 and a total of 268, 16 under par, on the par-71 Yokohama Country Club. He earned $1.44 million, his third PGA Tour title. Keith Mitchell and Jacob Bridgeman tied for second at 15 under and each earned $704,000. Mitchell shot 68. Bridgeman shot 69. Defending champion Xander Schauffele tied for fourth at 13 under. Max Homa tied for 13th at 11 under. Hideki Matsuyama tied for 21st at 9 under.
stakes: One shot decided the title. Brennan started the last round tied at 13 under with Bridgeman and Zach Bauchou.
rivalryAngle: Schauffele was the defending champion and finished tied for fourth. The event was not a first-time tournament.
funFacts: Brennan closed with a 3-under 68. Total 268. Winner's check $1.44 million.
Mitchell and Bridgeman tied for second at 15 under, $704,000 each.
Homa finished T13 at 11 under. Matsuyama finished T21 at 9 under.
